items.title: Making upgrades for our DIY project
items.description: We wanted to make DIY kits out of this project. Our requirements: - couldn't take too long to assemble, - can't require the maker to have a 3D printer, - but also needs to be expandable if you have a 3D printer. After literally 2 years of prototypes and writing the assembly instruction, we made it. And now we can make upgrades :) Checkout https://www.cpsdrone.com/cps3/ to buy the CPS 3 Kit and get instructions for free (included with the kit).
